status: Qualified runtime optimization; full goal ACTIVE and incomplete
component: Bounded backend-owned reusable temporary expert projection buffers

behavior.scope: Existing internal native forward/placement API, not new CLI/model admission
behavior.backend: CUDA opts into synchronous exclusive-idle-buffer refill; backends without refill support keep create/destroy behavior
behavior.ownership: Backend expert store owns one lazy triplet per temporary reservation slot. Immutable model anatomy/CPU weights/core tensors are unchanged. Pending slot prevents reuse while a lease is live; only released idle storage may be overwritten.
behavior.layout: Original context, format, k/n geometry, marker and exact byte count must match. Different idle layout is destroyed before replacement; no changed expert routing/grouping, quant arithmetic or source head geometry.
behavior.publication: Refill keeps cudaMemcpy followed by default-stream completion before publication, preserving the cross-nonblocking-consumer guarantee. Existing request completion before lease release remains.
behavior.failure: Reject invalid shape/context/marker without writes. Transfer failure may poison data; store destroys the entire affected triplet, aborts reservation, leaves caller output unpublished. Cached decode handles and other slots are untouched.
behavior.lifetime: Idle temporary storage is retained until store close, still inside the same temporary quota. Close refuses live leases and frees all retained storage.
behavior.accounting: temporary_allocated_payload/temporary_peak_payload include idle and leased reusable storage. temporary.charged_payload counts active reservations and overlaps that allocation, so do not add the two. Backends without refill support report zero reusable allocation; their active storage remains charged by reservations.

workload.profile: Explicit Diffbot INT4 BF16 row lookup -> Exllama F16 Engram execution adapter; not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence
workload.fixture: 513 fresh + 513 resumed + five source-self-fed greedy tokens; context1031, maxseq1280, f16acc0
workload.timing: Three plain passes per configuration, no observer callbacks. Monotonic host time for history staging through completed CPU-logit publication; preparation and verification excluded.
workload.warmth: OS/disk page-cache warmth and clocks uncontrolled. Repeated fixed sequence, not a serving-arrival distribution or general hit-rate prediction.

memory.notes: Device peak from separate Nsight allocation events; excludes untracked driver/context/rounding overhead. Idle footprint rises versus immediate release but remains within the pre-existing temporary budget; peak for this workload is unchanged. RAM/VRAM core, cache, activation and mapped-file budgets remain separate.

ram_limited_vram_supplement.notes: Two passes, 48 VRAM expert slots versus 1024 RAM slots. Replayed decode hits RAM but misses VRAM; GPU transfers and decode-cache create/eviction costs remain. This tests actual RAM-warm offloading, not full VRAM residency or disk-cold behavior.

qualification.scope: Bounded reusable native expert buffers: geometry-preserving whole-model window1/window32 and phase-policy timing/counters, exact independent CPU/GPU source values, BUSY and poisoned-refill ownership tests, sanitizer/compatibility gates. Not vLLM parity.

validation.synthetic_tests: Budget/pinned isolation, stale and malformed lease rejection, refill data across keys, partial poisoned-refill cleanup, create rollback and complete teardown
validation.cuda_tests: Wrong size/shape/format/marker/context rejected; zero/refill/restore precedes unchanged original EXL3 FFN reference checks
validation.busy: Four interruptions per probe; normal and ASan/UBSan probes preserve host publication/history, drain partial lease, retain original query106/score132/topk132 totals and reproduce source values

trace.scope: Supplementary Nsight trace only; separate from uninstrumented performance samples
trace.phase_interval: Embedding CUDA dispatch through the start of the external half-logit verification transfer; includes original final-logit publication and synchronization, excludes setup/reset, initial embedding upload, external verification
trace.notes: Separate Nsight trace, excluded from performance table. Fourteen source-exact forwards. ROI begins at embedding dispatch and stops before external verification, including normal final-logit publication; setup/reset/initial embedding upload/verification excluded. Whole-process totals include setup.

limits: No vLLM parity comparison for this adapter; fully resident matched comparisons remain required
Decode-cache eviction still creates/destroys its own buffers; only temporary expert storage is reused
Upload publication remains blocking and per projection; no claimed transfer overlap or removed synchronization wait
No new production tokenizer/CLI/serving admission, continuous batching or KV scheduling
Whole-model large-context two-level candidates, CPU native execution and all-model/backend acceptance remain incomplete
